summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.68/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.68 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 17, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 8¢ higher than a week ago, 6¢ lower than a month ago, and 80¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.42) and the highest in Superior ($3.98).
